items.title: Mr. and Mrs. A.C. Synigal Interview, 1962-05-24
items.q: I know Bunk played with it. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah.

ctx.x: You had a block dance right in front of it.

Mrs. Well, it was to be in front, but with the rain we had it inside, indoors. Mrs. Indoors, because of, well, we had, our first block dance was here. Mrs. On the street, yeah. Mrs. On the street. Mrs. On the street. Mrs. On the street. And the city blocked off the street. Johnson and Praia, and they put boots on both sides of the street and we had a lot of doors. Mrs. So that we can sell our wares. Mrs. One was the ice cream booth. Mrs. The hot dog booth. Mrs. What else? Mrs. Hot dog, barbecue booth. Mrs. And…
It's got a train on the back. Mrs. Oh yeah, it has a train, yeah.
